title: Deliver Wood to Wrinwood Sawmill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Wrinwood Sawmill** (industry id 16, near tile 201,248).

A likely supplier is **Wrinwood Forest** (industry id 12, near tile 234,239); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **370 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
